events.title: Bug report
events.summary: Hi there,big bug is not what was planned to write now, but life goes like that. It only affected new players (for demo that means nearly everybody). When starting campaign for the first time, instead of first mission info there was placeholder text and image. This probably cost us a lot of players, cause not many people want to play "Lorem ipsum" mission. events.title: What was done in march - dev update
events.summary: Hi electricity fans! Another month has passed and we're here to report on that. No screenshots this time, because most of the work was done "under the hood". Things like load & save, game settings, menu items and similar. Steam integration has begun and we have added first achievements and prepared for cloud storage. events.title: Development Update – What’s New?
events.summary: Hello grid builders! It’s been quite busy month since we launched our “Coming Soon” page! February is shortest one of the whole year, but we manage to squeeze reasonable amount of work from it. New grid elements have been added to available building arsenal - Distribution Substation and High Voltage Lines. This allows hierarchical structure of the grid, which was previously unavailable.
